title: Space-Creating versus Dead Possession: An Off-Ball Possession-Quality Index for Broadcast Football
description: Event-side junk-possession index and spatial Space-Creation Index (SCI) for distinguishing space-creating from dead possession in broadcast football. Includes the index, a validation battery (correlations, cross-fitted out-of-sample splits, and a VAEP non-reducibility regression with match-clustered standard errors) over 103 of the 104 matches of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and a spatial study of 31 flagged windows from a purposive nine-match sample.
